item.title: Our Top Shows at the 2017 BRIC Celebrate Brooklyn! Festival
item.description: Reminisce with us and warm up thinking back to the summer #AtTheBandshell! We had some amazing artists hit the stage in 2017, but here were our top shows based on how many of YOU came out to enjoy them. Thanks for making it a great year—we can’t wait for 2018! The post Our Top Shows at the 2017 BRIC Celebrate Brooklyn! Festival appeared first on BRIC.

item.title: OPEN (C)ALL: TRUTH WINNERS ANNOUNCED
item.description: This year’s OPEN (C)ALL: TRUTH exhibition featured the work of over 125 artists from BRIC’s Contemporary Artist Registry, each responding to the question “What is real and true for you?” From the exhibition, two awardees emerged - a "Viewer's Choice" winner, determined through votes by the public; and a "Best in Show" winner, determined by members of BRIC's Contemporary Art staff and select past exhibition artists. item.title: Featured Artist: Rita Leduc
item.description: Brooklyn-based Rita Leduc is a multimedia artist who uses installation, photography, collage, and drawing to examine the impact of place. Taking a democratic approach in her selection of location, each series embodies what the artist refers to as the “sensorial fingerprint” of each space.
